notes: Squaw Valley removed as a duplicate of Palisades Tahoe (resort renamed 2021). Fixed typo Mayrhofer -> Mayrhofen. Kept workarounds four-by-four (desert travel) and eighteen-wheeler (truck types) as they are common names; added 4x4 and 18-wheeler beside them. Left plain where English sources mostly do: Hawaii Volcanoes (no okina), Iznik, raki, Da Nang, Thingvellir. Parc Astérix and Enterprise (shuttle) kept as real places/vehicles. Souvenir sub-themes judged not separate (kimono, tequila, fez read as souvenirs).
